Hi Priyom,

We're starting SummitPay's vendor recertification for the 11/15 board packet and have a couple items to align on before we loop legal. High level: SummitPay needs confirmation of your SOC 2 recert timeline, an updated list of evidence artifacts we can pull for our auditors, and a proposal to extend our retention window from 180d to 365d (for regulatory reasons).

Specific asks: 
- Can Redwood confirm SOC 2 recert date (or expected attestation month) and what artifacts you'll make available?
- If we move to 365d retention, will there be an additional monthly fee or a one-time migration charge?
- We also want to increase committed seats for Q1 to accommodate an upcoming traffic burst. Can you outline the commercial uplift and whether capacity can be provisioned before contract execution?

Appreciate a concise plan, and happy to put legal on a call if needed.

Thanks,

Lena — thanks for the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can support a 365d retention horizon and fast-track capacity, but there are two threads (compliance artifacts + commercial amendment) we should run in parallel so you have minimum risk to your timeline. Proposed next steps: 

1) Compliance artifacts: Kimberly will list the deliverables and a simple extraction plan we can run for your auditors (logs, access snapshots, change history). Expect a one-page manifest by EOD tomorrow.

2) Retention & cost: We'll model the incremental storage and ingestion costs and provide (a) a one-time ingestion charge if historical rehydration is needed, and (b) recurring monthly delta for 365d retention. I'll include a pricing snapshot in the contract amendment.

3) Capacity/seat uplift: We can provision a temporary dedicated burst pool prior to contract signature if SummitPay signs an interim MOU or provides a purchase order that covers the uplift. Otherwise, provisioning happens post-execution but we can queue the capacity.

Can we do a 30-minute alignment call Friday 10/30 at 10am PT? If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Hi all — Kim here from Solutions & Compliance. Short artifact runbook and options below. I'll keep it high level so your auditors can map to control points.

What we can provide (standard package):
- System activity logs (API request/response traces) — CSV export, 90d default; can extend to 365d.
- Authn/authz snapshots (IAM role assignments, recent MFA events) — evented snapshot.
- Config change history (model pins, infra changes) — JSON timeline.
- Incident timeline & postmortems (if applicable) — redacted versions.
- Evidence manifest (mapping to SOC 2 CC controls) — human-readable spreadsheet.

Retention options:
A) 365d rolling retention (preferred): additional recurring storage charge estimated at 
   - $0.02 per GB/month incremental (ballpark; will produce exact numbers)
   - One-time rehydration fee if you want historical backfill >180d (depends on volume)
B) 365d + archival tiering: keep recent 90d hot, 275d warm archive with lower retrieval SLA and 30% lower storage cost.

Capacity/Seats: We can queue a dedicated burst pool (N+2 GPUs) for the requested Q1 traffic spike. Options: 
- Pre-provision (requires PO or signed MOU covering 3 months of uplift) — can stand up in ~5 business days.
- Post-signature provisioning — typically 10–12 business days.

Commercial guidance: Ben, can you draft a short amendment with price ranges (storage delta + seat uplift) that we can share with SummitPay legal? Marissa — we'll want to include a short SLA note on evidence exports (48–72h turnaround for manifests).

I'll attach the evidence_manifest CSV template and a sample retention estimate.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions & Compliance
Redwood Inference
